title: Lebanese judge issues warrants for five detained Hezbollah members
detail: A Lebanese judge issued arrest warrants for five Hezbollah members detained in a mountainous area between Batroun and Bsharre in northern Lebanon, and ordered three others brought in for questioning, a judicial official told AFP. They face proceedings for allegedly forming an armed group, recruiting and arming members. A Hezbollah lawmaker called the detentions unjust. The move comes amid growing pressure on Hezbollah to surrender its weapons.

media.caption: Lebanese judge issues warrants for detained Hezbollah members

title: Qassem: any post-UNIFIL force outside UN authority will be treated as occupier
detail: Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem said in a speech on Al Manar that any international force replacing UNIFIL would be treated as an occupying force unless it operates under UN authority, and rejected the 26 June US-brokered 14-point Lebanon-Israel framework as a basis. UNIFIL's mandate ends 31 December 2026, with gradual withdrawal from January.

media.caption: Hezbollah chief rejects any post-UNIFIL force outside UN authority
